name: MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI — simplified launch candidate
readme:
# MOSS-Image SFT ComfyUI

Deploy a Pod, open **Connect → MOSS ComfyUI**, and choose one of the four bundled workflows. Runpod supplies the connection token; there is no separate MOSS password to create.

First launch downloads and verifies **23.51 GB** of public models. The connection page shows preparation progress and opens the workflows when ready. No Hugging Face token or terminal command is required.

Use one NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM and a CUDA 13.0-compatible host. The candidate requests a 60 GB container disk so first use needs no storage edit. Select persistent storage mounted at `/workspace` if you want to retain models, edited workflows and images when stopping or replacing the Pod; the current launch screen chooses storage separately from the template.

## Startup script

The image includes `/opt/moss/scripts/entrypoint.sh`. The template explicitly runs that command through the image's `tini` entry point. It initializes Runpod SSH, prepares the models, starts the protected connection page, and supervises ComfyUI. Do not replace it with a model-download command.

## Candidate status

This is the private 0.1.1 simplified-launch candidate. The public template still uses validated 0.1.0. Candidate source/browser checks have passed; its built-image, fresh GPU deployment, native Runpod Connect and restart checks are pending. Do not publish until those checks pass for the exact candidate digest.

Workflows, API documentation and licenses: https://github.com/akhilsivanand/moss-runpod
